candidates.title: Little Ones Storytime
candidates.description: Join Librarian Heidi on Wednesday mornings at 10:30AM for Little Ones Storytime at Children's Library. Storytime includes a variety of early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, and movement activities. Storytime is a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of reading and learning for all ages. Storytime will be held inside when the garden is unavailable.
candidates.tips:
This program is targeted to children under the age of two and their caregivers.
Please note that this storytime is an indoor/outdoor program.
Access to the Secret Garden outside is weather dependent.

candidates.title: Music & Movement
candidates.description:
Bring your dancing feet to the Mitchell Park Library on Wednesday evenings for Music & Movement with Librarian Celina. Build early literacy skills through movement, songs, and dance.

 Instruments, songs, and dance moves will all be introduced so that everyone will be able to enjoy moving along to the music.

 This program is meant for families with children and no previous experience is needed!

candidates.title: Chill Out with Mindfulness Meditation
candidates.audiences: Adults; Kids (6-11); Pre-schoolers (3-5); Seniors; Teens (14-18); Toddlers (18 mos. to 3 yrs); Tweens (11-13)
candidates.description: Center yourself and increase your focus with mindfulness meditation led by Phuong Pham. Each session begins with an introduction to meditation, 15 minutes of sitting and releasing meditation, and group sharing and Q&A. This program is open to all ages, young and old, and all levels of experience. Chairs are available for adults who do not bring them. Phuong is a Buddhist nun experienced in leading mindfulness meditation. You can learn more about Phuong here and can watch her meditation videos on
candidates.tips:
Children under 10 years old must be accompanied by an adult.
No registration is required.
Participants are encouraged to bring their own yoga mats and/or meditation cushions.
